parole.significato: A solid block of more or less pure metal, often but not necessarily bricklike in shape and trapezoidal in cross-section…
parole.testo: From Middle English ingot (“mould for casting metal”), of uncertain origin. In all likelihood the same word as Middle French lingot, but the direction of borrowing is hard to establish, particularly as the word appears simultaneously (ca. 1390) in both languages. * Assuming English origin, from Old
